description: This Java source file defines the class ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorBuilder, which is a builder for creating instances of ImmutableJsonFieldSelector. It provides methods for adding, removing, and managing JSON pointer references and field definitions to construct a JSON field selector. The class implements the JsonFieldSelectorBuilder interface and is part of a package related to JSON processing in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorBuilder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing ImmutableJsonFieldSelector objects, managing JSON pointers and field definitions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of ImmutableJsonFieldSelectorBuilder.

methods.name: addPointerString
methods.description: Adds a JSON pointer from a string, along with optional additional pointer strings.

methods.name: addPointerStrings
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointers from an iterable of strings.

methods.name: addPointer
methods.description: Adds a JSON pointer object and optional additional pointers.

methods.name: addPointers
methods.description: Adds multiple JSON pointer objects from an iterable.

methods.name: addFieldDefinition
methods.description: Adds a field definition and possibly additional field definitions, adding their pointers.

methods.name: addFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Adds multiple field definitions, adding their pointers.

methods.name: addFieldSelector
methods.description: Adds pointers from an existing JsonFieldSelector.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString
methods.description: Adds a field selector based on a string, with parse options.

methods.name: addFieldSelectorString (overload)
methods.description: Adds a field selector string using default parse options.

methods.name: removePointers
methods.description: Removes multiple pointers from an iterable.

methods.name: removePointerString
methods.description: Removes a pointer specified by its string representation.

methods.name: removeFieldDefinition
methods.description: Removes a field definition and its pointer.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableJsonFieldSelector instance with the current pointers and string.
